rubric.method: Pace and Pitch variation scores = 100 * (1 - flagged_seconds / duration), where overlapping flagged intervals are merged and clipped to audio duration. Pauses score = 100 * (1 - flagged_pauses / pauses_examined). Loudness is measured but unscored. Overall score is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the unrounded scored dimensions rounded once to one decimal (round half up; minimum 2 scored dimensions required, otherwise null).
rubric.method_note: A score of 100 means the detectors flagged nothing. It does not prove the delivery was good.
rubric.reliability_note: Compared with an ideal recording of the same speech
rubric.overall_note: Overall uses 2 of 4 dimensions: Pace, Pitch variation

dimensions.name: Pace
dimensions.criterion: Evaluates speech tempo consistency and flags intervals where speaking rate is significantly too fast or too slow.

dimensions.name: Pitch variation
dimensions.criterion: Evaluates melodic intonation variation and flags intervals where vocal pitch is abnormally flat or monotone.
